props.name: values
props.description: One array per row, one value per column. `null` marks a cell with no data.

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of colour steps between the lowest and highest value.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower end of the scale. Defaults to the smallest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper end of the scale. Defaults to the largest value.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Print each value inside its cell.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Height of each row in viewBox pixels.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in cells, the legend and the tooltip.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: What a value measures, for the tooltip and the legend — “Retention”.
